breaking.change: SpriteBlend and StripBlend are one enum, Blend: alpha 0 and additive 1 everywhere (StripBlend had additive 0). og.Trail, og.Beam and RibbonDesc still default to additive, sprites to alpha; the variant strings are unchanged, so `blend: "alpha"` means what it did. A saved og.Trail or og.Beam keeps its blend (og.Trail and og.Beam take version 2 and a save step).
breaking.fix: Rename the type SpriteBlend or StripBlend to Blend where game code names it.
